fact: Government spokesman Paulo Tecas announced the creation of a digital platform with the tax authority AGT to link IGCA, AGT, the matrix cadastre and the Property Registry Conservatoria, to speed up property legalisation and registration, with a target of 40,000 properties by end of 2026.
Esri says GEODATA built a distributed cadastre system holding 450,000 urban parcel boundaries, distributed to all 18 IGCA province offices and linked to the registry offices' registration system.
Esri says GEODATA implemented the property registration system in all 22 registry offices in all 18 provinces of Angola.
Secretary of State for Justice Osvaldo Amaro said the Executive is creating computer systems to ensure no conflicts between holders of property titles, as part of the property registration services.

Presidential Decree 188/24 sets rules for a 14-digit property identification number (NIP) assigned by the Serviço Central de Cadastro, requires registration in the Sistema Integrado de Cadastro Predial, and gives holders of existing land titles six months to submit them.
